Improve open-source discovery, trust, adoption and revenue with practical repository changes.

## When to use it

Grow an open-source agent skill repo by auditing positioning, README, install flow, demos, launch assets, marketplace metadata, contribution paths, and OSS-to-paid conversion. Use when the user wants to increase GitHub stars, installs, contributors, repo trust, agent-skill directory visibility, or revenue from an open-source repo.

Example request:

> Use repo-growth-operator to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill repo-growth-operator
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/repo-growth-operator/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/repo-growth-operator/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
